not_applicable_policy: Retained as an evidence status; the upstream uncertainty contract has no NOT_APPLICABLE state.
uncertainty_policy: Discriminated available/unavailable variants make NOT_AVAILABLE payload fields impossible in a valid plan.
defer_policy: Planner copies governed decision state and emits no claims when DEFER is active.
reference_policy: All plan claim, limitation, contradiction, and realization references must resolve; duplicates and unknown IDs fail closed.
semantic_plan_hash: SHA-256 over canonical EXT4F_CANONICAL_JSON_V1 content excluding plan_id and semantic_plan_sha256
